hook_line: CABINET CLEARS RS 14,500 CRORE STORAGE FUND BACKING 92 GWH OF NEW GRID CAPACITY

hook_stat.sub: Grid-scale energy storage capacity supported by the scheme

stats.label: Viability gap funding approved by the Union Cabinet on Wednesday
Pumped hydro storage — the largest share of the capacity
Battery energy storage systems under the scheme

diaspora_bullets: Battery projects under the scheme must meet a minimum 40 per cent domestic content requirement
The scheme covers roughly a fifth of the assessed need of 411 GWh by 2031-32
news_summary: The Union Cabinet on Wednesday approved a Rs 14,500 crore viability gap funding scheme to support 92 GWh of grid-scale energy storage capacity.
payoff: The scheme runs from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31.
